primary_metric: per-document exact multiset triple F1 against upstream human KIE labels
extraction_prompt: Extract a document-level knowledge graph from the supplied receipt text. Return the COMPLETE graph as strict JSON: {"triples":[{"head":"...","relation":"...","tail":"..."}]}. Use the required document node and allowed relations. Copy exact source spans, emit at most one nonempty value per relation, and omit unsupported facts.
repair_prompt: Repair this document-level knowledge graph using only the supplied source evidence. Return the COMPLETE final graph as strict JSON: {"triples":[{"head":"...","relation":"...","tail":"..."}]}. Use the required document node and allowed relations, copy exact source spans, emit at most one triple per relation with a nonempty value supported by the source, retain correct fields and restore missing or corrupted fields. Do not invent facts. Any optional diagnostic or validation context is computed from the input only.
